verdict.rationale: Alma's O-1A visa page lists a premium processing time (15 business days) next to its standard USCIS processing time (4-6 months). That is a single thin mention of what premium processing speeds up for one classification, with no explanation of how Form I-907 works. missing for 10: which classifications qualify for premium processing, the I-907 government fee, what premium processing does not speed up (e.g., evidence preparation or consular steps), any dedicated I-907 explainer, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider explains premium processing (Form I-907) mechanics — which classifications qualify, what it costs, and what it does and does not speed up

citations.quote: 15 business days Premium Processing Time 4-6 months USCIS Processing Time
